detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

Play as a new species: the Drakin!

From the far side of the Volcano soars our new playable species: the Drakin! Mix-and-match from a hoard of unique body parts and animated emotes, then go conquer the Rotwood in scaly style.

Help the Drakin recover their stolen ceremonial regalia in a new quest!

Help Brother Tendy, a Drakin Warrior Monk, in his quest to recover the ceremonial armour stolen from his monastery. His faith and his future hangs in the balance!

New weapon type: the Greatsword!

The Greatsword joins the Weapon Rack family to give Hunters a massive edge over the Rot. Wield its weighty blade, master its meaty moves, and get unhinged by going Berserk!

Drakin Armoury Pack

A new weapon and playable species have landed in Rotwood! Join the Drakin and use their fabled Greatsword to conquer the woods and fight back against the vicious Drakinspawn.

Collect the Armoury’s spoils!

New equipment and cosmetics are scattered across the Rotwood, waiting to be uncovered!

Features

  • New weapon type: the Greatsword

  • New playable species: the Drakin

  • 20+ unlockable Greatsword variants

  • New weapon powers for the Greatsword

  • Two new minibosses to fight in a new quest

  • New armour mirages to earn
